verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway is open-source and explicitly documented as self-hostable via Docker/DB-less deployment, with declarative configuration, Kubernetes Ingress Controller, and hybrid control-plane/data-plane models available without vendor lock-in (kong-gh-4, kong-gh-7, kong-gh-17, kong-gh-20). This is corroborated by the GitHub repo itself being the deployable artifact. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of a fully self-hosted AI Gateway/MCP stack (vs. Konnect SaaS) and clearer docs on self-hosting the newer AI/MCP features specifically.
